lessons.title: Savol berish mashinasi: Do you ...? Does she ...?
lessons.goal: Present Simple'da savol berishni va qisqa javob berishni o'rganasiz. Shahar, do'kon va manzil lug'ati.

frame.name: Do / Does + ega + fe'l
frame.formula:
Do you work here?            Yes, I do.
Does she live in the city?    No, she doesn't.
Where do you work?            I work at a bank.
frame.explain: Savol yasash uchun yordamchi fe'l — do yoki does — eganing oldiga chiqadi. So'roq so'zi (where, what, why) bo'lsa, u eng oldinda turadi, keyingi tartib o'zgarmaydi: Where + do + you + work?
table: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.

neg: You don't work in a shop.
She doesn't work at a pharmacy.
q: Do you work in a shop?
Does she work at a pharmacy?
short: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

examples.en: Do you work in the city center or in a small town?
examples.uz: Shahar markazida ishlaysizmi yoki kichik shaharchadami?

examples.en: Does this street go to the park?
examples.uz: Bu ko'cha bog'ga olib boradimi?

examples.en: Where is the nearest pharmacy?
examples.uz: Eng yaqin dorixona qayerda?

examples.en: Is there a supermarket on the corner of this street?
examples.uz: Bu ko'chaning burchagida supermarket bormi?

examples.en: My office is in a big building near the museum.
examples.uz: Mening ofisim muzey yaqinidagi katta binoda.

examples.en: Does your company have a factory in another country?
examples.uz: Kompaniyangizning boshqa mamlakatda zavodi bormi?

examples.en: I don't know his address, but I know the road to his house.
examples.uz: Uning manzilini bilmayman, lekin uyiga boradigan yo'lni bilaman.

examples.en: Is the capital city far from this town?
examples.uz: Poytaxt bu shaharchadan uzoqmi?

street.title: Yo'lda so'rash

items.en: Go straight, then turn left at the bridge.
items.uz: To'g'riga yuring, keyin ko'prikda chapga buriling.

street.note: "around the corner" — "burchakda, juda yaqin" ma'nosida; "corner" so'zi bilan "at / on the corner" ishlatiladi.

lines.en: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy near here?
Yes, there's one on the corner, next to the bakery.
Does it work on Sundays?
I think so, but the one in the mall is always open.
lines.uz: O'ylaymanki ha, lekin savdo markazidagisi doim ochiq.

lines.en: Where's the mall?
Go straight down this road, it's near the stadium.
lines.uz: Shu yo'ldan to'g'riga yuring, stadion yaqinida.

substitution.prompt: ___ you live in a big city? (do / does)
substitution.answer: Do you live in a big city?

substitution.prompt: ___ she work at the museum? (do / does)
substitution.answer: Does she work at the museum?

substitution.prompt: ___ your company have an office here? (do / does)
substitution.answer: Does your company have an office here?

translate.en: Where do you work?
She doesn't work at a pharmacy.
Where is the nearest market?
Does this street go to the museum?

fix.wrong: Does you work in a shop?
fix.right: Do you work in a shop?

fix.why: savolda yordamchi fe'l kerak va -s unga o'tadi

fix.wrong: Do he live in a town?
fix.right: Does he live in a town?

lessons.tip: So'roq so'zi bo'lsa ham tartib bir xil: Where + do/does + ega + fe'l. "Where you live?" emas — Where do you live?

lessons.title: Yoqmaydi: don't / doesn't
lessons.goal: Inkor gapni to'g'ri yasashni o'rganasiz va uy mebeli lug'atini o'zlashtirasiz. doesn't bilan -s yo'qolishini eslab qolasiz.

frame.name: don't / doesn't + fe'l
frame.formula:
I / you / we / they + don't + fe'l   → I don't like this sofa.
he / she / it + doesn't + fe'l       → He doesn't want a table.
We don't have a microwave.
frame.explain: Inkor uchun yordamchi fe'ldan keyin not qo'yiladi: do not = don't, does not = doesn't. Eng muhim qoida: doesn't dan keyin fe'l o'zak shaklda qoladi — She doesn't work, "She doesn't works" emas, chunki -s allaqachon does ichida.
table: No, I don't. / No, she doesn't.

neg: She doesn't want a new carpet.
q: Does she want a new carpet?
short: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.

examples.en: I don't like this old sofa — it is too soft.
examples.uz: Bu eski divan menga yoqmaydi — juda yumshoq.

examples.en: We don't have a microwave in the kitchen.
examples.uz: Oshxonamizda mikroto'lqinli pech yo'q.

examples.en: She doesn't want a big wardrobe in her bedroom.
examples.uz: U yotoqxonasida katta shkaf xohlamaydi.

examples.en: There is a mirror above the shelf, but there isn't a lamp near the bed.
examples.uz: Tokcha ustida oyna bor, lekin karavot yonida chiroq yo'q.

examples.en: He doesn't put his keys on the table.
examples.uz: U kalitlarini stolga qo'ymaydi.

examples.en: Do you need a blanket or a sheet for the sofa?
examples.uz: Divan uchun adyol kerakmi yoki choyshab?

examples.en: My grandmother doesn't use the oven — she cooks on the stove.
examples.uz: Buvim pechdan foydalanmaydi — gaz plitasida pishiradi.

examples.en: Don't put the box on the clock, please.
examples.uz: Iltimos, qutini soat ustiga qo'ymang.

street.title: Uy ichida

items.en: Can you give me a towel?
The key is under the carpet.

street.note: "Make yourself at home" — mehmonga aytiladigan standart jumla, so'zma-so'z "o'zingni uy qil" deb tarjima qilinmaydi.

lines.en: Do you like this flat?
It's OK, but I don't like the kitchen. It doesn't have a fridge.
lines.uz: Yomon emas, lekin oshxona yoqmayapti. Unda muzlatgich yo'q.

lines.en: There is a fridge in the hall.
Really? And where's the table?
There isn't a table, but there are two chairs and an armchair.
lines.uz: Stol yo'q, lekin ikki stul va kreslo bor.

lines.en: OK, I'll buy a table and a lamp.
lines.uz: Mayli, stol va chiroq sotib olaman.

substitution.answer: She doesn't want a new bed.

substitution.prompt: He ___ have a wardrobe in his room. (inkor)
substitution.answer: He doesn't have a wardrobe in his room.
We don't need a big table.

translate.en: I don't like this old armchair.
There isn't a mirror in his room.
We don't need a microwave.
She doesn't want this carpet.

fix.why: doesn't dan keyin fe'l o'zak shaklda

lessons.tip: doesn't dan keyin fe'lga -s qo'shilmaydi: She doesn't work. Xuddi shu qoida did va can uchun ham amal qiladi: She didn't go, She can't swim.

lessons.title: Uy ichida: in, on, under
lessons.goal: Joy predloglarini o'zlashtirasiz va uy qismlari lug'atini o'rganasiz: deraza, devor, zinapoya, quvur.

frame.name: Joy predloglari
frame.formula:
The cat is under the table.
The keys are on the windowsill.
The bathroom is next to the bedroom.
The lamp is between the bed and the window.
frame.explain: Joy predloglari o'zbek tilidagi kelishiklarga o'xshaydi, lekin ular otdan oldin turadi: "stol ustida" → on the table. Eng kerakli yettitasi: in, on, under, behind, next to, between, in front of.
table: oldida — in front of the house

aff: The kitchen is next to the hall.
My shoes are under the bed.
neg: The kitchen isn't next to the hall.
My shoes aren't under the bed.
q: Is the kitchen next to the hall?
Are my shoes under the bed?
short: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

examples.en: The bathroom is next to the bedroom, and the toilet is behind the stairs.
examples.uz: Hammom yotoqxona yonida, hojatxona esa zinapoya orqasida.

examples.en: There are two windows in the living room, and a balcony in front of them.
examples.uz: Mehmonxonada ikki deraza va ularning oldida balkon bor.

examples.en: My room is on the second floor, under the roof.
examples.uz: Mening xonam ikkinchi qavatda, tom ostida.

examples.en: The switch is on the wall near the door.
examples.uz: Vyklyuchatel eshik yonidagi devorda.

examples.en: There is a socket under the window, behind the curtain.
examples.uz: Deraza ostida, parda orqasida rozetka bor.

examples.en: Is there a shower in the bathroom or only a faucet?
examples.uz: Hammomda dush bormi yoki faqat jo'mrak?

examples.en: The pipe goes from the kitchen to the roof, next to the chimney.
examples.uz: Quvur oshxonadan tomga, mo'ri yonidan o'tadi.

examples.en: Put the towel on the windowsill, please.
examples.uz: Iltimos, sochiqni rom ustiga qo'ying.

street.title: Uy ichida
street.note: Amerikada faucet, Britaniyada tap — ikkisi ham "jo'mrak". "Upstairs / downstairs" — yuqori / pastki qavat.

lines.en: Is your flat big?
Not very. There's a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen and a small bathroom.
lines.uz: Unchalik emas. Mehmonxona, yotoqxona, oshxona va kichik hammom bor.

lines.en: Where do you keep your bike?
In the garage, next to the gate.
And is there a garden?
Yes, but it's small — just one tree in front of the window.
lines.uz: Ha, lekin kichkina — deraza oldida bitta daraxt.

substitution.answer: The cat is under the table.
The mirror is on the wall.

substitution.prompt: The kitchen is ___ the living room. (yonida)
substitution.answer: The kitchen is next to the living room.

substitution.prompt: My room is ___ the second floor. (qavatda)
substitution.answer: My room is on the second floor.
The keys are in the box.

translate.en: The bathroom is next to the bedroom.
My room is under the roof.
There is a tree in front of the window.
The switch is on the wall near the door.

fix.wrong: The cat is in the table.
fix.right: The cat is on the table.

fix.wrong: There are a mirror on the wall.
fix.right: There is a mirror on the wall.

fix.wrong: My room is in the second floor.
fix.right: My room is on the second floor.

lessons.tip: in / on / at farqi: in — ichida (in the room, in the box); on — yuzasida, tegib turadi (on the wall, on the floor); at — nuqta (at the door, at the bus stop).

lessons.title: Nima yoqadi? I like / I don't like
lessons.goal: Did va yoqtirish haqida gapirishni o'rganasiz: like / love / hate, savol va inkor. 25 ta asosiy oziq-ovqat so'zi.

frame.name: like + ot / fe'l-ing
frame.formula:
I like fish.            I don't like pork.
He likes rice.          Does she like soup?
I love it. / I hate it. / I don't mind it.
frame.explain: like dan keyin ot yoki fe'lning -ing shakli keladi: I like fish, I like cooking. Darajalar: love (juda yaxshi ko'raman) → like → don't mind (qarshi emasman) → don't like → hate.

short: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.

examples.en: I like bread with butter and cheese for breakfast.
examples.uz: Nonushtaga sariyog' va pishloqli non yoqtiraman.

examples.en: She doesn't like pork, but she likes chicken and lamb.
examples.uz: U cho'chqa go'shtini yoqtirmaydi, lekin tovuq va qo'y go'shtini yaxshi ko'radi.

examples.en: Do you like fish soup or meat soup?
examples.uz: Baliq sho'rvami yoki go'sht sho'rvami yoqadi?

examples.en: My brother doesn't eat eggs, and he doesn't like salad.
examples.uz: Akam tuxum yemaydi va salatni yoqtirmaydi.

examples.en: We usually have rice with vegetables and a cutlet.
examples.uz: Biz odatda sabzavotli guruch va kotlet yeymiz.

examples.en: Is there any flour in the cabinet? I want to cook noodles.
examples.uz: Shkafda un bormi? Lag'mon pishirmoqchiman.

examples.en: He likes porridge and oatmeal in the morning.
examples.uz: U ertalab bo'tqa va suli bo'tqasini yoqtiradi.

examples.en: I don't like mushrooms, but I love corn and sandwiches.
examples.uz: Qo'ziqorinni yoqtirmayman, lekin makkajo'xori va buterbrodni juda yaxshi ko'raman.

street.title: Ovqat haqida

items.en: What do you feel like eating?

street.note: "I'm starving" — so'zlashuvda "juda ochman"; kitobiy shakli "I'm very hungry".

lines.en: What do you want for lunch?
I'd like chicken soup and a salad, please.
Do you like fish? We have fresh fish today.
lines.uz: Baliq yoqadimi? Bugun yangi baliq bor.

lines.en: No, I don't like fish, but I like beef.
lines.uz: Yo'q, baliqni yoqtirmayman, lekin mol go'shtini yaxshi ko'raman.

lines.en: Beef with rice or with potatoes?
lines.uz: Mol go'shti guruch bilanmi yoki kartoshka bilan?

lines.en: With rice, please. And some bread.
lines.uz: Guruch bilan, iltimos. Va bir oz non.

translate.en: I like meat.
She doesn't like fish.
Do you like mushrooms?
I eat eggs and bread for breakfast.

lessons.tip: Sanalmaydigan otlar: bread, rice, meat, butter, milk, flour — ularga a/an qo'yilmaydi va -s qo'shilmaydi. "a bread" emas — some bread yoki a piece of bread.

lessons.title: Bir oz, bir nechta: some, any, no
lessons.goal: Miqdor so'zlarini o'zlashtirasiz va ziravor hamda sabzavot nomlarini o'rganasiz.

frame.name: some / any / no
frame.formula:
I need some salt.                    → tasdiq
Do we have any onions?               → savol
No, we don't have any onions.         → inkor
There is no garlic in the kitchen.
frame.explain: some — bir oz, bir nechta (tasdiq gaplarda). any — savol va inkor gaplarda. no — "hech qanday", inkor ma'nosini beradi, lekin gap tasdiq shaklida qoladi: There is no garlic. Ikkita inkorni bir gapda ishlatmang.

short: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

examples.en: I need some salt and a little pepper for the soup.
examples.uz: Sho'rvaga bir oz tuz va murch kerak.

examples.en: Do we have any onions?
examples.uz: Piyoz bormi?

examples.en: There aren't any carrots in the fridge, but there are some potatoes.
examples.uz: Muzlatgichda sabzi yo'q, lekin kartoshka bor.

examples.en: He doesn't like garlic, so there is no garlic in the sauce.
examples.uz: U sarimsoqni yoqtirmaydi, shuning uchun sousda sarimsoq yo'q.

examples.en: Would you like some vegetables with your rice?
examples.uz: Guruchingizga sabzavot olasizmi?

examples.en: My mother puts dill and parsley on the potatoes.
examples.uz: Onam kartoshka ustiga ukrop va petrushka soladi.

examples.en: There are beans, peas and lentils in this salad.
examples.uz: Bu salatda loviya, no'xat va yasmiq bor.

examples.en: Is there any pumpkin in the market today?
examples.uz: Bugun bozorda qovoq bormi?

street.title: Bozorda

items.en: Give me two kilos of potatoes, please.

street.note: Bozorda "a little bit more" — "bir oz ko'proq" degani; "a little" sanalmaydigan narsalar bilan, "a few" sanaladiganlar bilan (11-dars).

lines.en: Do we need any vegetables for dinner?
Yes, buy some tomatoes and a cucumber.
Is there any garlic at home?
No, there isn't any. And we don't have any dill.
Do you want some nuts too?
No, thanks. But buy some sweet pepper — it's good for salad.
lines.uz: Yo'q, rahmat. Lekin bir oz shirin qalampir oling — salatga yaxshi.

substitution.prompt: There is ___ garlic in the sauce. (no / any)
substitution.answer: There is no garlic in the sauce.

translate.en: I need some pepper.
Are there any carrots in the fridge?
There is no onion at home.
Are there any fresh tomatoes at the market?

lessons.tip: some savolda ham uchraydi, lekin ma'no o'zgaradi: Do you have any onions? — umuman bormi? Would you like some tea? — taklif, shuning uchun some.
